one_line_summary: Expand existing FlytBase autonomous drone operations to three new Atacama lithium sites, leveraging SQM's successful history with Adentu and the Q3 Salar Futuro budget cycle.

buyer_context.who: Rodrigo Castillo, Head of Operations, Northern Operations Division
what_he_cares_about: Reducing costs of contracted inspection crews
Scaling autonomous inspection to support the US$3B Salar Futuro project

others_involved.name_or_role: Rodrigo Toler (Deputy Manager of Digital Innovation)
others_involved.why: Existing internal champion who understands the history of the FlytBase/Adentu deployment [S37].
Top-level executive overseeing the Salar Futuro strategy [S1, S14].

unknowns: Specific technical requirements for new sites

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM is an existing customer that achieved 4x iodine yield improvement and 95% mission reliability using FlytBase [S37].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: This is a 'land and expand' opportunity; the technology is already proven within their infrastructure.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM has a US$3B investment plan through 2028 focused on the Salar Futuro project [S9, S23].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Aligning the drone expansion with this specific initiative increases the likelihood of budget approval.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM has a goal to be carbon neutral in all products by 2040 [S29].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Position autonomous drones as a sustainability tool that reduces vehicle-based site inspections.

recommended_case_study.title: How SQM Turned a 678 km² Mine into an Autonomous Inspection Zone
recommended_case_study.why: It validates the existing partnership and provides the specific ROI metrics needed to justify expansion to the new Atacama sites.

suggested_next_step.action: Schedule a discovery call with Rodrigo Castillo, involving the Adentu account lead.
suggested_next_step.rationale: The lead is P1-Hot; leveraging the existing Adentu relationship immediately will accelerate trust and technical validation.

watch_outs: Do not treat this as a cold lead; acknowledge the existing Adentu/FlytBase deployment.
Be prepared for long procurement cycles typical of large-scale mining operations.
Ensure the solution integrates with their existing Azure/Databricks data framework.
